spec.description: Fraction of permission hook calls that were auto-denied over the past hour. High values mean few commands are in the allowlist. Renders as No data when no hook calls have occurred in the window.

spec.description: Number of autonomous merge attempts blocked by gh-merge-guard in the last 24h. Should be zero in normal operation; non-zero means Claude tried to merge a vet:pending or vet:complete PR autonomously and was correctly stopped.

spec.description: CLAUDE.md-violating Bash operations observed by claude-dangerous-ops-detect in the selected time window, grouped by pattern. Any non-zero bar means Claude attempted an invariant-violating operation — investigate the corresponding hook-dangerous-ops.jsonl entry.
